definition: Well meaning and kindly; wishing to do good to others
example_sentence: The benevolent neighbor brought warm soup to the elderly couple during the blizzard.

definition: Truthful and straightforward; frank in speech or expression
example_sentence: She gave a candid assessment of the project's chances of success.

definition: Having or showing care and conscientious effort in one's work
example_sentence: The diligent student spent hours researching primary sources for her thesis.

definition: Sparing or economical with regard to money or resources
example_sentence: By living a frugal lifestyle he managed to save enough money to buy his first home.

definition: Expressed clearly and easy to understand
example_sentence: The professor gave a lucid explanation of a complex quantum mechanics concept.

definition: Able to withstand or recover quickly from difficult conditions
example_sentence: The community proved resilient after rebuilding the town following the storm.

definition: Calm peaceful and untroubled; tranquil
example_sentence: The surface of the mountain lake was completely serene at sunrise.

definition: Connected with the sense of touch or perceived through touching
example_sentence: Children often learn best through tactile experiences like sculpting clay.

definition: Feeling or showing caution about possible dangers or problems
example_sentence: The hiker grew wary of rustling sounds in the dense bushes ahead.

definition: Great energy or enthusiasm in pursuit of a cause or objective
example_sentence: She tackled the charity campaign with contagious zeal and determination.

definition: Open to more than one interpretation; having a double meaning

definition: Expressing thoughts and ideas clearly and effectively in speech or writing
example_sentence: He was exceptionally articulate when defending his research findings to the board.

definition: Severe or strict in manner or appearance; without luxuries or comforts

definition: Support or strengthen; prop up something weak

definition: Lasting for a very short time; fleeting or transient

definition: Showing great attention to detail; very careful and precise

definition: Dealing with things sensibly and realistically based on practical considerations

definition: Behaving or looking as though one thinks one is superior to others; arrogant

definition: Present appearing or found everywhere at the same time

definition: Regard with great respect; hold in profound esteem or reverence

definition: Accept something reluctantly but without protest; submit passively

definition: Demonstrating aggression and willingness to fight; hostile or warlike

definition: Given to sudden and unaccountable changes of mood or behavior; erratic

definition: Causing harm or damage often in a subtle or unexpected way

definition: Cause someone to feel drained of energy or vitality; weaken

definition: Fond of company; sociable and outgoing

definition: Tending to talk a great deal; talkative

definition: Deliberately make something obscure unclear or difficult to understand

definition: Having or showing keen mental discernment good judgment and wisdom
